subject.title: fix(skill-workshop): validate apply body and show change summary before destructive writes

question: Should automatic Skill Workshop approval gain a conditional safety exception for updates that lack substantial continuity with the current skill?
rationale: Current main intentionally defaults lifecycle actions to automatic approval, while this PR adds an operator-visible exception whose threshold and short-skill behavior define product policy rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Keep a bounded safety exception
options.body: Require approval for demonstrably low-continuity updates, but first enforce required skill metadata and make the continuity threshold proportional for short skills.

options.title: Preserve unconditional auto approval
options.body: Land only structural body validation and change summaries, leaving every structurally valid update under the configured automatic policy.

options.title: Approval-gate every update
options.body: Require operator approval for all update applies, accepting the broader regression from the recently established automatic workflow.

recommendation.title: Keep a bounded safety exception
recommendation.body: Require approval for demonstrably low-continuity updates, but first enforce required skill metadata and make the continuity threshold proportional for short skills.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged change established the automatic-approval behavior whose permanent exception must be confirmed.
